# Giant Shark (`monsters:giant-shark`)
*Huge beast, unaligned* | **CR** 5 (XP 1,800; PB +3)
**AC** 13 | **HP** 92 (8d12 + 40) | **Speed** 5 ft., swim 60 ft.
**STR** 23 (+6) | **DEX** 11 (+0) | **CON** 21 (+5) | **INT** 1 (-5) | **WIS** 10 (+0) | **CHA** 5 (-3)
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +3
**Senses:** Blindsight 60 ft., Passive Perception 13
**Languages:** None

## Traits
- **Water Breathing.** The shark can breathe only underwater.

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The shark makes two Bite attacks.
- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +9 (with Advantage if the target doesn’t have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Piercing damage.
